author: Hacken
description: Detector monitors Cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) health and security: CloudWatch alarms, IAM events and S3 availability

faq.name: How does it work
faq.value:
Detector periodically queries Cloud provider API and generates Alerts for problems found: 

- `Watch` (CloudWatch): alarms (VPC, EC2, EKS and other services health)
- `Trail` (CloudTrail): management events (IAM changes, security groups, bucket policies, ...). Only write events by default: `track_event` adds all other events, including read-only (`Get*`, `List*`, ...), with `INFO` severity
- `IAM`: insecure IAM configuration (root access keys, missing MFA, old access keys)
- `Storage` (S3): buckets availability

AWS is supported. GCP and Azure are **mocked** for now.

faq.name: Cron
faq.value: Cron interval to check Cloud. Refer to [Cron](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#cron) for more details

faq.name: URI
faq.value:
Cloud URI: `aws://`, `gcp://`, `azure://`

Format: `cloud://ACCESS_KEY:ACCESS_SECRET[:SESSION_TOKEN]@[host]?param=value&param=value`

If credentials are not specified, they are read from environment variables `AWS_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_ACCESS_SECRET`, `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`, `AWS_REGION` (`GCP_`, `AZURE_` for other clouds). Region and account: parameters `region=` and `account=` or environment variables `AWS_REGION`, `AWS_ACCOUNT` (`GCP_REGION`, `GCP_ACCOUNT`, `AZURE_REGION`, `AZURE_ACCOUNT`), parameters have priority. Region and account are added to every Alert. Alerts also have `system` (generic: `Watch`, `Trail`, `IAM`, `Storage`) and `sys` (Cloud specific name, e.g. `CloudWatch`, `CloudTrail`, `IAM`, `S3` for AWS) metadata. `ref` is a link to open the finding in the Cloud console, `tx_hash` is the unique id of the event/entity assigned by the Cloud provider (Trail: EventId, Watch: alarm ARN, IAM: user ARN, Storage: bucket ARN).

Examples:

`aws://?region=eu-west-1&account=123456789012`

`aws://AKIA...:SECRET@?region=eu-west-1`

`aws://?region=eu-west-1&states=ALARM,INSUFFICIENT_DATA&namespace=AWS/EC2,AWS/EKS` (Watch)

`aws://?source=iam.amazonaws.com&events=CreateUser,DeleteUser&window=60` (Trail)

`aws://?max_key_age=90` (IAM)

`aws://?buckets=my-bucket,my-bucket-2&latency=3000`

faq.name: Credentials refresh
faq.value:
Temporary credentials (`SESSION_TOKEN`, SSO) **expire** and a static `SESSION_TOKEN` is never refreshed while Detector is running. Credentials sources (in order of priority):

1. Keys in URI (`aws://KEY:SECRET[:TOKEN]@`)
2. `profile=NAME` - profile from shared credentials file (`~/.aws/credentials` or `profile_file=/path`). Profile can use `credential_process` (SSO, Vault, any external refresher), which is called again when credentials expire
3. Environment keys `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`/`AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`
4. AWS default chain (nothing specified): IAM role for ECS/EKS (IRSA)/EC2 - **recommended for production**, refreshed automatically

If keys (URI or environment) are specified **without** `SESSION_TOKEN`, the session token is requested from STS (`GetSessionToken`) and renewed automatically (disable with `sts=false`). If `SESSION_TOKEN` is specified it is used as is and **expires**.

Add `role_arn=ARN` (optionally `external_id`, `role_session`, `role_duration` seconds) to assume a role: credentials are refreshed automatically before expiration.

Examples:

`aws://?region=eu-west-1` (IAM role of the host/pod)

`aws://?region=eu-west-1&role_arn=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Sentry&external_id=abc`

`aws://?region=eu-west-1&profile=sentry`

faq.name: Condition
faq.value: Condition on the number of findings (per system) to generate Alerts. Default is `> 0`. Refer to [Condition](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition-threshold) for more details

faq.name: Track New
faq.value: Alert only once on every new finding. If disabled, all active findings are reported on every check

faq.name: Track Events
faq.value: `Trail` only. By default Alerts are generated only for write (mutating) CloudTrail events: `HIGH` severity for security sensitive ones, `MEDIUM` for others. If enabled, Alerts are also generated for read-only events (`Get*`, `List*`, `Describe*`, ...) with `INFO` severity. Use `source` and `events` URI parameters to limit the volume

faq.name: Timeout
faq.value: Max time (milliseconds) to wait for Cloud API

faq.name: Track Error
faq.value: Track and alert on Errors (Cloud access errors, invalid credentials)
